exercises.paragraph: For the following exercises, the equation of a surface in rectangular coordinates is given. Find an equation of the surface in spherical coordinates. Identify the surface.

For the following exercises, the cylindrical coordinates of a point are given. Find its associated spherical coordinates, with the measure of the angle $$\varphi$$ in radians rounded to four decimal places.
For the following exercises, the spherical coordinates of a point are given. Find its associated cylindrical coordinates.
For the following exercises, find the most suitable system of coordinates to describe the solids.

problem.paragraph: The solid situated in the first octant with a vertex at the origin and enclosed by a cube of edge length $$a,$$ where $$a > 0$$

solution.paragraph: Cartesian system, $${(x,y,z)|0\le x\le a,0\le y\le a,0\le z\le a}{(x,y,z)|0\le x\le a,0\le y\le a,0\le z\le a}$$

problem.paragraph: A spherical shell determined by the region between two concentric spheres centered at the origin, of radii of $$a$$ and $$b,$$ respectively, where $$b > a > 0$$
A solid inside sphere $$x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 9$$ and outside cylinder $$\left( {x - \frac{3}{2}} \right)^{2} + y^{2} = \frac{9}{4}$$

solution.paragraph: Cylindrical system, $${ ( r , \theta , z ) | r 2 + z 2 \le 9 , r \ge 0 , \pi 2 \le \theta \le 3 \pi 2 , ( r \ge 3 cos \theta , - \pi 2 \le \theta \le \pi 2 ) } { ( r , \theta , z ) | r 2 + z 2 \le 9 , r \ge 0 , \pi 2 \le \theta \le 3 \pi 2 , ( r \ge 3 cos \theta , - \pi 2 \le \theta \le \pi 2 ) }$$

problem.paragraph: A cylindrical shell of height $$10$$ determined by the region between two cylinders with the same center, parallel rulings, and radii of $$2$$ and $$5,$$ respectively
[T] Use a CAS to graph the region between elliptic paraboloid $$z = x^{2} + y^{2}$$ and cone $$x^{2} + y^{2} - z^{2} = 0.$$ Then describe the region in cylindrical coordinates.

solution.paragraph: The region is described by the set of points $${(r,\theta ,z)|0\le r\le 1,0\le \theta \le 2\pi ,r2\le z\le r}.{(r,\theta ,z)|0\le r\le 1,0\le \theta \le 2\pi ,r2\le z\le r}.$$

problem.paragraph: [T] Use a CAS to graph in spherical coordinates the “ice cream-cone region” situated above the xy-plane between sphere $$x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 4$$ and elliptical cone $$x^{2} + y^{2} - z^{2} = 0.$$

Washington, DC, is located at $$39^\circ$$ N and $$77^\circ$$ W (see the following figure). Assume the radius of Earth is $$4000$$ mi. Express the location of Washington, DC, in spherical coordinates.
San Francisco is located at $$37.78^\circ \text{N}$$ and $$122.42^\circ \text{W} .$$ Assume the radius of Earth is $$4000$$ mi. Express the location of San Francisco in spherical coordinates.
Find the latitude and longitude of Rio de Janeiro if its spherical coordinates are $$\left( {4000,-43.17^\circ,102.91^\circ} \right).$$
Find the latitude and longitude of Berlin if its spherical coordinates are $$\left( {4000,13.38^\circ,37.48^\circ} \right).$$
[T] Consider the torus of equation $$\left( {x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} + R^{2} - r^{2}} \right)^{2} = 4R^{2}\left( {x^{2} + y^{2}} \right),$$ where $$R \geq r > 0.$$

list.item: Write the equation of the torus in spherical coordinates.
If $$R = r,$$ the surface is called a horn torus. Show that the equation of a horn torus in spherical coordinates is $$\rho = 2R \sin \varphi.$$
Use a CAS to graph the horn torus with $$R = r = 2$$ in spherical coordinates.

problem.paragraph: [T] The “bumpy sphere” with an equation in spherical coordinates is $$\rho = a + b \cos (m\theta)\sin (n\varphi),$$ with $$\theta \in \lbrack 0,2\pi\rbrack$$ and $$\varphi \in \lbrack 0,\pi\rbrack,$$ where $$a$$ and $$b$$ are positive numbers and $$m$$ and $$n$$ are positive integers, may be used in applied mathematics to model tumor growth.

list.item: Show that the “bumpy sphere” is contained inside a sphere of equation $$\rho = a + b.$$ Find the values of $$\theta$$ and $$\varphi$$ at which the two surfaces intersect.
Use a CAS to graph the surface for $$a = 14,$$ $$b = 2,$$ $$m = 4,$$ and $$n = 6$$ along with sphere $$\rho = a + b.$$
Find an equation of the intersection curve of the surface at b. with the cone $$\varphi = \frac{\pi}{12}.$$ Graph the intersection curve in the plane of intersection.
